audit.repeated_within_bank_note: a repeat across two different cases is a property of the frozen sampler's support, not an isolation failure; only within-case duplication and Phase 9 overlap are rejected

isolation.rule: no arrangement a Phase 10 case fixes may have a final setup fingerprint in this set

manifest.access_justification: Phase 10 validation bank: frozen candidate-selection evaluation cases (Agent 1 construction)
manifest.bootstrap_unit: the logical case, scoring the mean of its two games
manifest.case_family_meaning: the fixed opponent setup's primary family
manifest.case_id_rule: case_index = family_index * cases_per_family + case_ordinal over families F00..F15; case_id = '<bank_version>|ms=<master>|f=<family>|c=<ordinal:03d>'
manifest.colour_pairing: the selector under test plays Red in game 0 and Blue in game 1 against the same fixed opponent setup

isolation.rule: no arrangement a Phase 10 case fixes may have a final setup fingerprint in this set

manifest.match_seed_rule: case_match_seed(case_id, game_index, matchup_token), independent of arm and candidate
manifest.no_outcome_selection: construction plays no game, loads no model and reads no strength signal; draws are rejected only for family identity, fingerprint isolation and within-case distinctness
manifest.opponent_draw_rule: first attempt k with sample_setup(split, case_opponent_setup_seed(case_id, k), profile='neutral_v1') whose primary family is the case family and whose final setup fingerprint is outside the Phase 9 held-out set
manifest.selector_seed_rule: first attempt k whose neutral_v1 draw for case_selector_seed(case_id, colour, k) is outside the Phase 9 held-out set and distinct from the case's other frozen setups; the walk reads the baseline only, so it is arm-independent

sealing.access_log_rule: every test-bank access is recorded with its purpose
forbidden_before_agent_7: playing any game on a case
computing any model metric on a case
hyperparameter or threshold selection using a case
